title: lantana odorata
intro: Lantana odorata, commonly known as Fragrant Lantana, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This shrub-like plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Lantana odorata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's essential oil, obtained through steam distillation, is used in aromatherapy to promote relaxation and reduce stress.
